description: Push live sensor data into the Afferens sensory layer. Use this when your AI agent is connected to physical hardware and wants to contribute real-time perception events. The data becomes queryable via afferens_perceive. Requires AFFERENS_API_KEY.

data.description: The raw sensor payload. Shape depends on modality — e.g. spatial_coords for SPATIAL, decibels for ACOUSTIC.

modality.description: Sensory modality of the data being ingested.

name: afferens_ingest
